sources.title: Hackers target major Wall Street firms with AI voice phishing attacks
sources.snippet: A wave of AI-powered voice phishing attacks, known in security circles as "vishing," has targeted major Wall Street hedge funds and private equity firms, with cybercriminals deploying voice-cloning technology to impersonate executives and trusted colleagues.
